correctness.rationale: The source proves the unique positive equilibrium for each k. The exact implicit-function Jacobian is I−diag(a)P with a^Tv=7/18, yielding the summation response (a^T(D^k−P)x^0)/(1−a^Tv)+O(||D^k−P||²). For the exact positive rational Beverton–Holt example, x^0=(2/3,1,4/3), b=x^0−(1,1,1), D^6=P+(I−P)/64 and the 6 scaled nonzero dot products give h=(4,−1,−5,−4,1,5). Since ||D^k−P||=O(2^-k), the error is O(4^-k) and is dominated by the six nonzero O(2^-k) coefficients. The two-patch analytic obstruction follows from D^k=P+λ^k(I−P) and the first nonzero Taylor monomial. The standard-library checker reproduces all 72 rational coefficients and 27 illustrative equilibria; finite examples are corroborative only.

originality.rationale: The exact six-class, infinitely recurring sign reversal for equilibrium total abundance as the integer power of one *fixed* migration matrix increases is not implied by the closest inspected publications. The source 2026 paper explicitly says that when the limiting total equals the sum of carrying capacities, convergence alone leaves the finite-k sign undecided (Section 3, immediately after Theorem 2). The present proof resolves that equality case for a concrete three-habitat example with nonzero exact coefficients. The 2025 multi-patch paper observes multiple switches while varying a continuous migration-intensity parameter; these are distinct control families and finite numerical catalogs, not a six-class infinite recurrence theorem. Historical priority remains subject to independent assessment.

value.rationale: In the 2026 source, total realized asymptotic abundance relative to isolated carrying-capacity sum is the central motivating statistic; Section 3 explicitly warns that perfect-mixing equality leaves finite-k direction unresolved. The exact sixfold pattern resolves that boundary case, proving arbitrarily many sign reversals as the natural time-scale ratio grows. The sharp two-habitat obstruction gives structural content; the result is stronger than plotting finite signs and informs interpretation of ecological fast-dispersal approximations. No empirical significance is claimed.
